title: Tamales Tolimenses
description: Tamales Tolimenses is a dish from Colombia featuring masa harina, chicken thigh, potato, carrot. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Mix the corn flour with the measured water and salt until a soft cohesive, non-sticky masa forms. Rest covered for about 10 minutes; this gluten-free dough does not become elastic like wheat dough.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 28 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Place a portion of prepared filling on each leaf or wrapper, tuck in the sides and roll tightly into neat parcels.
Steam the already prepared parcels or mixture over gently boiling water for approximately 90 minutes, until fully cooked or set.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
